Package model

Class InventoryItem

java.lang.Object
model.InventoryItem
public class InventoryItem extends Object
One row of inventory_item: an ingredient, topping or supply stocked for one drink. The same ingredient appears once for every drink that uses it, so each row also records which drink it belongs to.
